subject: ACME: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - Final sign-off and go-live readiness
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME MAP draft & post-call recap

Hi Jordan - thanks again for the call earlier. Attached is the MAP draft (ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx) reflecting the milestones and owners we discussed. Quick recap and next steps:

Summary / goals:
- Goal: Production inference for ACME Search by 2026-04-30 (go-live)
- Primary success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 200ms for standard queries; accuracy measured on the ACME title-match eval (baseline +/- tolerance)

Proposed milestones (high level):
1) Contract & procurement: ACME procurement issues PO + countersign SOW - Owner: Procurement / ACME legal - Target: 2026-03-25
2) SSO & Networking: SAML SSO + VPC peering config complete - Owner: ACME infra / Redwood infra - Target: 2026-03-22
3) Integration & Data Prep: ingest sample dataset, validate embeddings - Owner: ACME data & Redwood integrations - Target: 2026-03-29
4) Performance validation & staging: run load test, evaluate latency/cost - Owner: Redwood SE (Marissa) + ACME eng - Target: 2026-04-12
5) Go-live cutover: production traffic ramp to 100% - Owner: ACME product + Redwood ops - Target: 2026-04-30

Dependencies / open items:
- Procurement timeline from ACME (PO/SOW)
- Network access window for VPC peering (ACME infra)
- Final eval set for quality checks from ACME data team

Ask: please review the attached MAP and confirm any edits by EOD Tuesday (3/17). If that works, we can plan a 15-min alignment call Wed 3/18 to lock sign-off and confirm signature readiness.

Link to editable MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=ACME_MAP_v2

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MAP draft & post-call recap

Camila - thanks for the recap and the draft. A few quick notes/requests from our side:

1) Procurement / Legal
- Procurement asked for a redlined SOW before they can route a PO. Can Redwood share the SOW draft we discussed? Legal will need ~3 business days once they have it.

2) SSO / Network timing
- SSO is on our critical path. We can schedule a 2-hour maintenance window next week for VPC peering, but need a clear list of required IP ranges and a contact to coordinate.

3) Go-live window
- Requesting we push the go-live target to 2026-04-30 (we prefer end of month to align with internal release calendar). If we agree, we need sign-off on the MAP by 2026-03-18 to keep the schedule.

4) Success criteria
- Can you confirm the exact metrics you'll use for 'accuracy' and who will own the evaluation run on our side? We will assign an ACME data owner once we see the eval checklist.

I'll loop in Patricia to confirm procurement timing. Otherwise this looks good - please send the SOW and updated MAP with the requested date and SSO dependency clarified.

- Jordan
Jordan Smith
Senior Product Manager, Search | ACME Corp
jordan.smith@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-17T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MAP draft & post-call recap (updated MAP + SOW draft)

Hi Jordan / team - thanks for the notes. I updated the MAP to reflect the requested go-live of 2026-04-30 and added a short SSO/network checklist under the 'Dependencies' column. Attached: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx and SOW-draft.pdf (stubs). Highlights of the updates:

- Contract & procurement: added SOW attachment and requested timeline for PO to be issued by 2026-03-25. (Owner: ACME procurement + Redwood legal)
- SSO & Networking: added required items - service IP ranges, SAML metadata, and our infra contact (neha.kapoor@redwood.com). Please confirm a 2-hour maintenance window for peering next week; proposed windows: 03/24 02:00-04:00 PDT or 03/25 01:00-03:00 PDT.
- Evaluation / Quality: included an 'Acceptance criteria checklist' (sheet 2) - accuracy evaluation will use ACME-provided title-match dataset (sample size ~5k). Redwood will run the initial eval in staging; ACME to validate results on their environment. Owner: ACME data + Redwood SE (Marissa).
- Rollout plan: added a phased ramp (10% -> 40% -> 100%) over 2 weeks post-cutover to monitor latency/cost.

Next steps / ask:
- Jordan / Patricia: please confirm procurement's ability to route PO by 2026-03-25 and confirm which maintenance window is preferable for peering.
- ACME data: please share the eval dataset by 2026-03-22 so Redwood can run the staging eval on 03/23-03/24.
- If we get confirmation by EOD 2026-03-18, Redwood will prepare final SOW for signature and schedule a 15-min sign-off call on 03/18 11:00 AM PT.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated MAP), SOW-draft.pdf (SOW stub).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-18T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MAP draft & post-call recap - Final sign-off

Camila / Marissa - confirming final sign-off from ACME side. Summary:

- Success criteria: ACME accepts the acceptance checklist in ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (accuracy eval metrics and latency targets).
- Procurement: Procurement has confirmed they will route PO by 2026-03-25; legal will countersign the SOW once we receive the final SOW (Marissa said you'd send).
- Network / SSO: We confirm the 03/25 01:00-03:00 PDT maintenance window for VPC peering. Our infra lead (bryan.lee@acme.com) will coordinate with Neha.
- Go-live: ACME confirms go-live target 2026-04-30. We will follow the phased ramp and monitor as discussed.

Please proceed to send the final SOW for signature and a DocuSign envelope for the MAP/SOW bundle. Once we have the signed SOW, procurement will turn the PO around. Attached is a signed stub of the MAP for tracking (ACME_MAP_signed.pdf).

Thanks for staying on this timeline - looking forward to the launch.

Patricia Gomez
Director, Platform Operations | ACME Corp
pat.gomez@acme.com
